module FlashLoan where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Types
type PoolId = String
type Amount = Integer
type PoolState = Map.Map PoolId Amount

data LoanConfig = LoanConfig
  { feeNumerator   :: Integer
  , feeDenominator :: Integer
  , maxLoanRatio   :: Integer  -- max percentage of pool (1-100)
  , minFeeAmount   :: Integer  -- minimum fee floor
  } deriving (Show)

data FlashLoanRequest = FlashLoanRequest
  { loanPool     :: PoolId
  , loanAmount   :: Amount
  , borrowerCb   :: PoolState -> IO PoolState
  , requestNonce :: Integer
  }

data LoanResult = LoanSuccess Amount | LoanFailure String
  deriving (Show)

-- Configuration
defaultConfig :: LoanConfig
defaultConfig = LoanConfig
  { feeNumerator   = 3
  , feeDenominator = 1000
  , maxLoanRatio   = 80
  , minFeeAmount   = 1
  }

-- | Compute the fee for a given loan amount
-- Fee = amount * numerator / denominator
-- With a minimum fee floor applied
computeFee :: LoanConfig -> Amount -> Amount
computeFee cfg amt =
  let rawFee = (amt * feeNumerator cfg) `div` feeDenominator cfg
      floorFee = minFeeAmount cfg
  in max rawFee floorFee

-- | Validate that a loan request is within acceptable parameters
validateLoanRequest :: LoanConfig -> PoolState -> FlashLoanRequest -> Either String ()
validateLoanRequest cfg pool req
  | loanAmount req <= 0 = Left "Loan amount must be positive"
  | otherwise =
      let poolBal = fromMaybe 0 (Map.lookup (loanPool req) pool)
          maxAllowed = (poolBal * maxLoanRatio cfg) `div` 100
      in if loanAmount req > maxAllowed
         then Left "Loan exceeds maximum ratio"
         else if loanAmount req > poolBal
              then Left "Insufficient pool liquidity"
              else Right ()

-- | Core verification: check that the pool was properly repaid
-- The post-callback pool balance for the target pool must be
-- at least the pre-loan balance plus the required fee
verifyRepayment :: LoanConfig -> Amount -> PoolState -> PoolState -> PoolId -> Either String PoolState
verifyRepayment cfg borrowedAmt preLoanPool postCbPool targetPool =
  let preBal = fromMaybe 0 (Map.lookup targetPool preLoanPool)
      postBal = fromMaybe 0 (Map.lookup targetPool postCbPool)
      requiredFee = computeFee cfg borrowedAmt
      expectedMin = preBal + requiredFee
  in if postBal >= expectedMin  -- must be at least pre-balance + fee
     then Right postCbPool
     else Left $ "Repayment verification failed: expected min balance "
               ++ show expectedMin ++ " but got " ++ show postBal

-- | Execute a flash loan atomically using modifyMVar
executeFlashLoan :: MVar PoolState -> LoanConfig -> FlashLoanRequest -> IO (Either String LoanResult)
executeFlashLoan poolVar cfg req = do
  modifyMVar poolVar $ \pool -> do
    case validateLoanRequest cfg pool req of
      Left err -> return (pool, Left err)
      Right () -> do
        let amt = loanAmount req
            pid = loanPool req
            pool' = Map.adjust (subtract amt) pid pool
            fee = computeFee cfg amt
        -- Execute borrower callback with debited pool
        resultPool <- borrowerCb req pool'
        -- Verify repayment
        case verifyRepayment cfg amt pool resultPool pid of
          Left err -> return (pool, Left err)
          Right finalPool -> return (finalPool, Right (LoanSuccess fee))

-- | Initialize a pool with given balances
initializePool :: [(PoolId, Amount)] -> IO (MVar PoolState)
initializePool balances = newMVar (Map.fromList balances)

-- | Query current pool state (read-only snapshot)
queryPool :: MVar PoolState -> IO PoolState
queryPool = readMVar

-- | Process multiple loan requests sequentially
processBatch :: MVar PoolState -> LoanConfig -> [FlashLoanRequest] -> IO [Either String LoanResult]
processBatch poolVar cfg = mapM (executeFlashLoan poolVar cfg)

-- | Health check: verify all pool balances are non-negative
healthCheck :: MVar PoolState -> IO Bool
healthCheck poolVar = do
  pool <- readMVar poolVar
  return $ all (>= 0) (Map.elems pool)
